planSteps.description: Find the password input field and enter 'My-Drop-Site' to unlock the site.
Verify the site loads in English by default with English text in navigation, hero, and buttons.
Find and click the language switcher (EN/AR toggle) in the header. Verify the site text switches to Arabic.
After switching to Arabic, verify the page layout changes to right-to-left (RTL). Navigation should align to the right.
Click the language switcher again to switch back to English. Verify all text returns to English and layout is left-to-right.
If on mobile viewport, verify the mobile bottom navigation bar appears with main navigation icons.
Look for a newsletter signup form in the footer or as a popup. Verify it has an email input and submit button.
Look for a WhatsApp floating button on the page. Verify it is visible and clickable.
Scroll down the homepage. Verify smooth scrolling works and the header remains visible or collapses appropriately.
Scroll through the homepage and collection pages. Verify product images load without broken image icons.
